operations.description:
Fetches analytics stats of a short Dynamic Link for a given
duration. Metrics include number of clicks, redirects, installs,
app first opens, and app reopens.
operations.T: [METHOD] get [NAME] firebasedynamiclinks link stats [PATH] link stats [PARAMS] access alt callback days duration dynamic fields key link oauth pretty print protocol quota sdk token type upload user version xgafv [SCHEMA] dynamic event link stat stats

operations.description:
Creates a managed short Dynamic Link given either a valid long Dynamic Link
or details such as Dynamic Link domain, Android and iOS app information.
The created short Dynamic Link will not expire.

This differs from CreateShortDynamicLink in the following ways:
  - The request will also contain a name for the link (non unique name
    for the front end).
  - The response must be authenticated with an auth token (generated with
    the admin service account).
  - The link will appear in the FDL list of links in the console front end.

The Dynamic Link domain in the request must be owned by requester's
Firebase project.
operations.T: [METHOD] post [NAME] firebasedynamiclinks managed short links create [PATH] managed short links create [PARAMS] access alt callback fields key oauth pretty print protocol quota token type upload user xgafv [SCHEMA] analytics android connect create desktop dynamic google info ios itunes link managed meta navigation play request response short social suffix tag warning

operations.description:
Creates a short Dynamic Link given either a valid long Dynamic Link or
details such as Dynamic Link domain, Android and iOS app information.
The created short Dynamic Link will not expire.

Repeated calls with the same long Dynamic Link or Dynamic Link information
will produce the same short Dynamic Link.

The Dynamic Link domain in the request must be owned by requester's
Firebase project.
